run_register_sensors_and_measures: run the habitat example to register a custom sensor and measure then reset and step the environment
create_custom_measure: create a custom habitat Measure subclass with reset_metric and update_metric methods registered via register_measure
create_custom_sensor: create a custom habitat Sensor subclass with get_observation and observation space registered via register_sensor
configure_measure_with_config: configure a custom measure by defining a MeasurementConfig dataclass with typed fields and a type string
configure_sensor_with_config: configure a custom sensor by defining a LabSensorConfig dataclass with typed fields and MISSING required values
